title: SF Board of Appeals No. 25-024: alteration permit at 14 Wilder Street issued to comply with an NOV; appeal denied, permit upheld
jurisdiction: City and County of San Francisco, California (comparative, non-Alberta)
code_edition: unknown if unstated; packet cites SF Building Code and California Mechanical Code sections without stating an edition
document_date: 2025-06-24 notice of appeal (permit issued 2025-06-12); Board action 2025-09-03 per minutes

facts.text: Notice of appeal: DBI issuance on 2025-06-12 of an Alteration Permit (revision to Permit No. 202501178595; reconfiguration of wall between kitchen, living room and dining room to comply with NOV No. 202536257) at 14 Wilder Street; application no. 2025/03/17/2402; hearing 2025-09-03.
Appellant's brief says the scope of the belated earlier application was narrower than the work observed (appellant's characterization).
Appellant quotes the alteration permit as describing only a wall reconfiguration to comply with the NOV, and calls that description misleading (appellant's characterization).
Appellant says a kitchen exhaust is not noted, described, or shown on any plans or permit application, although the California Mechanical Code and the NOV required it (appellant's claim).

Appellant cites SF Building Code sections 102A (unsafe building), 106A.3.1(1) (applications) and 106A.4.1 (work shown on approved plans); these are the appellant's citations, not verified against the code text.
Appellant cites Mechanical Code sections 104.1 and 102.5 (appellant's citations).
Appellant states there are no structural drawings, no electrical or plumbing plans, and no kitchen plans for the alteration permit (appellant's claim).
Appellant says a second NOV and final warning letter issued 2025-05-14 (appellant's account of the NOV sequence).
Packet exhibit index: Exhibit 1 (alteration permit), Exhibit 6 (photographs of kitchen exhaust vent), Exhibit 10 (Plans Regarding 14 Wilder St.; divider p.128).

Packet p.250 is an image-only structural sheet titled S3.0 '2nd Floor Framing Plan' (title block: Interior Remodel, 14 Wilder Street). The packet does not state whether this sheet was part of the permit under review.
Packet p.244 is an image-only excerpt of the 2022 California Green Building Standards Code (residential mandatory measures, sheet 2); it is general code text, not case-specific.
Respondent-side briefs are included: permit holder brief and Planning Department brief.
Board minutes, 2025-09-03, Item (5), Appeal No. 25-024: 'Upon motion by Vice President Lopez, the Board voted 4-0 to deny the appeal and uphold the permit on the basis that it was properly issued.'

limitations: Appellant's code citations and characterizations are unverified and are not code text.
Packet is 256 pages; 25 image-only pages; only pp.121, 124, 244 and 250 were rendered and inspected.
Outcome comes from minutes that cover several other appeals; those other items were not analyzed.
